reference_rule: Comparable work method and scale, or a concrete shared recurring obstacle that can inform duration. Mixed deliverables may have more than one non-interchangeable peer. Unlisted pairs are negatives. Task keys, setting, reference labels, completion waves, notes and observed times are hidden from Kev. Positive signs refer to semantic relevance, not a forecast being necessarily better.

boards.setting: Oral history volunteer, neighborhood interview day

tasks.title: Caption the ferry interview
tasks.description: Transcribe twelve minutes of a two-person oral history from the field recorder. Add speaker changes and timestamp uncertain names.

tasks.title: Index the shipyard tape
tasks.description: Listen to twelve minutes of dockworker testimony and type a timestamped transcript with speaker labels.

tasks.title: Type the night-shift recording
tasks.description: Make a verbatim speaker-tagged transcript of a twelve-minute WAV excerpt and flag inaudible words.

tasks.title: Mend the recorder pouch
tasks.description: Hand-stitch the split seam of the padded microphone bag, then test the zip.

tasks.title: Clear the ferry release form
tasks.description: Call the narrator to confirm consent for public playback and file the signed scan.

notes.A: The engines covered several surnames; I had to replay the same sentence several times.

boards.reference_rationale: All three audio excerpts need about the same amount of replay, transcription and speaker tagging. Sewing and consent clearance have distinct timing drivers.

boards.setting: Studio assistant getting pieces ready for pickup

tasks.title: Wax the bases on six blue mugs
tasks.description: Turn over six bisqued mugs, wipe their feet, brush on wax resist and check for missed spots before glazing.

tasks.title: Prepare the teacups for glaze
tasks.description: Apply wax resist to the foot rings of six small bisque cups after a damp wipe, touching up any bare sections.

tasks.title: Shoot the celadon set
tasks.description: Stage eight finished bowls against the sweep, adjust two lights and export shop photographs.

tasks.title: List the porcelain espresso cups
tasks.description: Light and photograph six finished cups on a neutral sweep, crop the product photos and export JPEGs.

tasks.title: Book a kiln technician
tasks.description: Phone the repair shop to arrange a test of the kiln relay; put the appointment on the studio calendar.

notes.C: Glossy glaze showed the softbox edges. Repositioning both lights took extra tries.

boards.reference_rationale: Two matched hand-waxing batches and two matched studio product shoots. The booking is independent.

boards.setting: Stream monitoring station after a sampling trip

tasks.title: Prepare yesterday's chloride samples
tasks.description: Run the benchtop titration on six water bottles; record duplicate endpoints and rinse the burette between bottles.

tasks.title: Run chloride checks on the upstream tray
tasks.description: Titrate duplicate six-bottle stream samples on the bench, rinse between runs, and enter the endpoints in the field sheet.

tasks.title: Walk the creek transect
tasks.description: Take GPS positions at the five stakes and photograph the flood marks from the bank.

tasks.title: Fix the sample-cooler latch
tasks.description: Drill out the broken rivets, install a replacement latch and verify the lid closes snugly.

tasks.title: Upload the creek GPS track
tasks.description: Convert the already recorded GPX file to GeoJSON, set its projection and add it to the county map.

notes.A: The indicator faded near the endpoint and two samples needed a fresh duplicate.

boards.reference_rationale: Matching titration batch sizes. Collecting GPS coordinates by walking and projecting a preexisting file are different operations.

tasks.title: Return the climbing harness
tasks.description: Walk to the gear counter, have staff inspect my borrowed harness and clear the loan.

tasks.title: Fix the union poster bleed
tasks.description: In the print layout extend the background by three millimeters, preflight the trim and export the PDF.

tasks.title: Practice the viola entrance
tasks.description: Work the exposed eight bars at four metronome speeds, then record a clean take.

tasks.title: Submit travel reimbursement
tasks.description: Match the rail receipts to card charges, convert one currency and submit the form.

tasks.title: Clean the espresso grinder
tasks.description: Unplug the grinder, remove the upper burr, brush out retained grounds and recalibrate the dial.

boards.reference_rationale: These five activities share a calendar and location; each has a different work method.

boards.setting: Digitization shift at a municipal records office

tasks.title: Capture 1908 ward cards
tasks.description: Feed twenty flat index cards through the scanner, deskew, verify both sides and name the TIFFs by box number.

tasks.title: Digitize twenty blue voter cards
tasks.description: Batch-scan twenty index cards front and back, deskew the images and save them under the archive naming convention.

tasks.title: Image the mayoral card drawer
tasks.description: Scan twenty loose record cards, check the backs for marginalia and rename the TIFFs by box and sequence.

tasks.title: Scan the west ward drawer
tasks.description: Digitize another twenty sturdy index cards front and back, straighten images and apply the same archival filenames.

tasks.title: Ingest the canal permit cards
tasks.description: Scan both sides of twenty unstapled index cards, deskew and assign box-sequence TIFF filenames.

boards.reference_rationale: All five batches have the same media, batch size, station and output checks.

boards.setting: Student robotics team preparing for the oval course

tasks.title: Characterize the left encoder
tasks.description: Spin the drive wheel at five commanded speeds, log encoder ticks over serial and fit a calibration line.

tasks.title: Verify the right wheel calibration
tasks.description: Command the wheel through five test speeds, capture serial encoder counts and regress ticks against measured revolutions.

tasks.title: Cut a battery spacer
tasks.description: Use the foam cutter to fit the battery tray and check the pack cannot slide in the chassis.

tasks.title: Send the pit sign-up
tasks.description: Collect four pit-crew availabilities in a form and email the final shift list.

tasks.title: Tune the camera threshold
tasks.description: Label ten saved course frames and adjust the HSV threshold against the labels; no wheel runs are involved.

boards.reference_rationale: Only the wheel characterization jobs share physical setup, serial logging and calibration fit.

boards.setting: Clothing repair bench with repeated and mixed work

tasks.title: Shorten the black trousers
tasks.description: Fit and pin both legs, remove the old hem, blind-stitch the new fold and press.

tasks.title: Take up the uniform pants
tasks.description: Pin the finished length, remove the existing stitching, blind-hem both legs, then steam the crease.

tasks.title: Replace the coat zipper
tasks.description: Unpick the separating zip, baste in a new one, topstitch and check that it runs true.

tasks.title: Mend the hem and zip on a skating costume
tasks.description: Split this repair between a blind hem on both trouser legs and replacing a separating zipper on the jacket. Both repairs are part of the delivery.

tasks.title: Dye cotton swatches for the costume
tasks.description: Measure dye stock into three baths and compare the finished swatches against the designer's reference in daylight.

boards.reference_rationale: The combined order D spans two individually recurring skilled operations. The zipper-only and hem-only orders have no comparable operation.

boards.setting: Library evening circulation and public program

tasks.title: Shelve the afternoon returns
tasks.description: Sort two full returns carts by call number, walk the stacks and check shelf order in the fiction aisle.

tasks.title: Put away the weekend return carts
tasks.description: Sort two carts of adult fiction by spine label and reshelve them, correcting obvious misfiles on the way.

tasks.title: Audit the poetry shelf
tasks.description: Compare forty poetry shelf labels with the catalogue and log missing or damaged copies without shelving returns.

tasks.title: Introduce the guest author
tasks.description: Read her bio aloud and moderate the scheduled ten-minute Q and A in the event room.

tasks.title: Edit the guest author's recording
tasks.description: Cut two applause breaks and remove hum from the saved event audio before exporting an MP3.

boards.reference_rationale: Two comparable reshelving batches. A shelf audit compares records, and facilitating an event and cutting its recording use different methods.

tasks.title: Swap passive bass pickups
tasks.description: Desolder the neck pickup, solder in its replacement and test its output on the bench.

tasks.title: Install the P-bass replacement
tasks.description: Remove the old passive pickup, solder the replacement into the harness and check output through the amp.

tasks.title: Set up the bass for recording
tasks.description: Set the truss rod, string height and intonation using a tuner and feeler gauges.

tasks.title: Set up the spare electric guitar
tasks.description: Adjust neck relief, saddle height and intonation on the bench with gauges and a tuner.

tasks.title: Learn the bass part by ear
tasks.description: Transcribe the bass changes from a reference track and rehearse them at tempo.

boards.reference_rationale: Two pickup replacements, and two stringed-instrument mechanical setups. Sharing an instrument alone supplies no timing evidence.

boards.setting: Bilingual exhibition labels and exhibit upkeep

tasks.title: Translate the first object caption
tasks.description: Render a 120-word French collection note in English and check personal names in the bilingual style sheet.

tasks.title: Draft English for the enamel label
tasks.description: Translate roughly 120 French words into English; verify names and museum terminology against the style guide.

tasks.title: Translate the copper caption
tasks.description: Produce a polished English translation of a short French object history and verify its names against the house glossary.

tasks.title: Install the enamel label
tasks.description: Level and mount the already printed caption at the marked height using removable strips.

tasks.title: Check glare on the enamel case
tasks.description: Adjust the track lamps, measure reflected light at wheelchair height and photograph the result.

boards.reference_rationale: Only the French-to-English label work shares language checks, output and scale.

tasks.title: Clean the bedroom roller shade
tasks.description: Take down the shade, vacuum with a soft brush, spot-clean and reinstall without creasing the fabric.

tasks.title: Fix the kitchen sink drip
tasks.description: Pull the faucet cartridge, match its O-rings, lubricate the seals and test the tap.

tasks.title: Balance last month's grocery receipts
tasks.description: Sort receipts by date, reconcile them with the card statement and split shared costs in the spreadsheet.

tasks.title: Hem the living room curtains
tasks.description: Measure their drop, pin the folds, run both hems on the sewing machine and press the seams.

tasks.title: Plan four packed lunches
tasks.description: Choose recipes that share ingredients, check the pantry and make a shopping list.

boards.reference_rationale: Home setting, fabric or money alone supplies no comparable operation for these tasks.

boards.setting: Trail group mapping and maintaining a park

tasks.title: Document the north trail culverts
tasks.description: Walk a one-kilometer sector, photograph each culvert and log location, blockage and diameter on a field sheet.

tasks.title: Survey drainage on the east loop
tasks.description: Walk the next kilometer, record a GPS waypoint and condition entry for each culvert and photograph its inlet.

tasks.title: Clear the east loop inlet
tasks.description: At the known blocked culvert, shovel out gravel, drag away branches and check runoff with a bucket.

tasks.title: Clear the south crossing
tasks.description: Remove compacted gravel and branches from a single drainage inlet and test the cleared channel with water.

tasks.title: Draw the trailhead sign
tasks.description: Illustrate the park loop and accessible route in a vector graphics file and export it at the sign shop's scale.

boards.reference_rationale: Stocktaking on foot and manual clearance of a known blockage are two distinct timing families.

tasks.title: Sync the kitchen interview
tasks.description: Line up two camera takes to a separate audio recorder using slate waveforms. Check for drift across the 20-minute cut.

tasks.title: Align the workshop interview
tasks.description: Use slate waveforms to sync two cameras with separate sound for a twenty-minute conversation; inspect the tail for drift.

tasks.title: Add closed captions to the kitchen cut
tasks.description: Type subtitle cues from the locked edit, time their breaks and correct speaker names before exporting SRT.

tasks.title: Caption the workshop cut
tasks.description: Transcribe the locked workshop interview into timed SRT captions, correcting speaker names and line breaks.

tasks.title: Deliver the kitchen sound and captions
tasks.description: For a twenty-minute two-camera interview, first align the separate sound against the slate, then transcribe and time a complete SRT file.

boards.reference_rationale: The combined delivery requires both the separate sync and captioning workflows. Individual sync jobs and caption-only jobs differ.

tasks.title: Prick out the tomato starts
tasks.description: Move a tray of forty seedlings into individual cells, water in and label each row by cultivar.

tasks.title: Pot the pepper seedlings
tasks.description: Transfer forty small starts into separate cells, backfill, water and add variety labels.

tasks.title: Move the squash starts
tasks.description: Pot up another forty seedlings into separate plugs and water and mark the rows.

tasks.title: Write the tomato bed placard
tasks.description: Draft a hundred words on the cultivar's provenance, verify the seed source and send text to the sign printer.

tasks.title: Repair the watering wand
tasks.description: Locate the leak at the trigger, replace the washer and pressure-test the wand.

boards.reference_rationale: Comparable forty-cell transplant batches; the sign and mechanical repair have different timing drivers.

boards.setting: Club workshop ahead of a field exercise

tasks.title: Terminate the short coax run
tasks.description: Strip two ends, crimp BNC connectors and check continuity and loss across the patch lead.

tasks.title: Build the antenna patch lead
tasks.description: Cut coax to length, crimp two BNC ends and test both continuity and insertion loss.

tasks.title: Write a field-day checklist
tasks.description: Compile the station opening sequence and emergency contacts into a printable one-page checklist.

tasks.title: Test the club repeater coverage
tasks.description: Drive the prescribed route and log received signal reports from the handheld at six stops.

tasks.title: Reserve a table at field day
tasks.description: Contact the community hall steward and confirm room access and a table for the radio station.

boards.reference_rationale: Two bench cable-termination jobs share steps. Other tasks share the radio theme alone.

boards.setting: Kitchen handover with two repeated prep tasks

tasks.title: Dice onions for the first service
tasks.description: Peel and hand-dice four kilograms of onions to the same size for the sauce station. Label and chill the pans.

tasks.title: Prep the soup onions
tasks.description: Hand-dice and pan four kilograms of peeled onions for the soup batch, check the cut size and chill them.

tasks.title: Audit first-floor fridge probes
tasks.description: Compare three refrigerator probes with a reference thermometer, record deviations and relabel the tested units.

tasks.title: Check upstairs fridge thermometers
tasks.description: Compare three cabinet probes with the calibrated reference and record deviations on the maintenance sheet.

tasks.title: Send the ingredient order
tasks.description: Review stock counts, apply the supplier's case minimums and submit next week's purchase order.

boards.reference_rationale: Two food-prep batches and two temperature-probe checks. Inventory purchasing uses different work.
